set system host-name DeviceB.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 10.10.1.2/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

family iso.explanation: Configure interfaces to support the ISO protocol community.

set protocols isis level 2.explanation: Configure the level of the ISIS protocol.

disable.explanation: The `disable` command in Junos deactivates a specific configuration element, making it non-operational without removing it from the configuration.

set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0.explanation: Enables an IS-IS protocol on the specified interface.

point-to-point.explanation: Configure the interface type of the IS-IS protocol as a point-to-point.
